comparisons.peer_summary: Beyond Code programs address skills development, staffing, change management, and cost-saving initiatives to help customers maximize mainframe investments and drive business success.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom discuss collaborating with stakeholders/customers to address broader business and environmental challenges, but they focus on different domains. Intel emphasizes leveraging technology to help customers lower emissions and energy usage (environmental), whereas Broadcom focuses on 'Beyond Code' programs that address skills, staffing, and change management to maximize mainframe investment value (operational/human capital).

sentences.text: We build energy efficiency into our products to help our customers lower their own emissions, energy usage, and costs, and we collaborate with policymakers and other stakeholders to use technology to address environmental challenges.
Our commitment to partnering with our customers goes beyond products and technology.

Through our unique Beyond Code programs we address challenges such as skills development, staffing, change management and cost-saving initiatives that drive greater overall business success with the platform.

comparisons.peer_summary: Micron proactively manages environmental compliance and sustainability, conforming its wafer fabrication facilities to the ISO 14001:2015 standard to ensure continuous performance improvement.
comparisons.comparison: Intel and Micron both disclose proactive environmental strategies involving energy efficiency and emissions, but Intel highlights product-level energy efficiency benefits for customers while Micron focuses on facility-level compliance and standards. Intel states it builds energy efficiency into products to help customers lower emissions, while Micron aligns its manufacturing facilities to ISO 14001:2015 standards for emissions and energy use.

sentences.text: We build energy efficiency into our products to help our customers lower their own emissions, energy usage, and costs, and we collaborate with policymakers and other stakeholders to use technology to address environmental challenges.

We continue to take action on emissions reduction strategies focused on emissions abatement, and to make additional investments in renewable electricity, process and equipment optimization, and energy conservation.

We approach environmental compliance and sustainability proactively to ensure we meet applicable government regulations regarding use of raw materials and chemicals, discharges, emissions, climate change and energy use, and waste disposal and management from our manufacturing processes.

As part of the ISO 14001 framework, we have established a global environmental policy and meet requirements, such as environmental aspects evaluation and control, compliance obligations, commitment, training, communication, document control, operational control, emergency preparedness and response, and management review.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company addresses climate impacts across its product lifecycle and assesses risks, including current and emerging regulations and market impacts.
comparisons.comparison: Intel and NVIDIA both explicitly address climate impacts and emissions reduction within their product lifecycles. Intel builds energy efficiency into products to help customers lower emissions and uses its technologies to enable other sectors to reduce their climate footprints. NVIDIA similarly addresses climate impacts across its product lifecycle and assesses related risks.

sentences.text: We build energy efficiency into our products to help our customers lower their own emissions, energy usage, and costs, and we collaborate with policymakers and other stakeholders to use technology to address environmental challenges.

This includes improving product energy efficiency and increasing the positive impact of our products by leveraging opportunities for Intel technologies to enable other sectors of the economy to reduce their climate and energy footprints.
In the area of environmental sustainability, we address our climate impacts across our product lifecycle and assess risks, including current and emerging regulations and market impacts.

comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA aims to purchase or generate enough renewable energy to match 100% of its global electricity usage for offices and data centers by the end of fiscal year 2025, having increased its matched renewable energy percentage to 44% in fiscal year 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Intel and NVIDIA both disclose specific renewable energy and emissions reduction goals as part of their environmental strategies. Intel focuses on making investments in renewable electricity and emissions abatement. NVIDIA has a specific goal to match 100% of global electricity usage for offices and data centers with renewable energy by the end of fiscal year 2025.

sentences.text: We continue to take action on emissions reduction strategies focused on emissions abatement, and to make additional investments in renewable electricity, process and equipment optimization, and energy conservation.
By the end of fiscal year 2025, our goal is to purchase or generate enough renewable energy to match 100% of our global electricity usage for our offices and data centers.
In fiscal year 2023, we increased the percentage of our total electricity use matched by renewable energy purchases to 44%.

comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm has established science-based emissions reduction targets approved by the SBTi, including a 50% reduction in absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions by 2030, a 25% reduction in absolute Scope 3 GHG emissions by 2030, and reaching net-zero GHG emissions across the value chain by 2040.
comparisons.comparison: Intel and Qualcomm both outline quantitative science-based targets for emissions reduction and net-zero goals. Intel describes actions on emissions reduction strategies including renewable electricity and optimization. Qualcomm establishes specific targets to reduce Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 50% and Scope 3 by 25% by 2030, and reach net-zero by 2040.

sentences.text: We continue to take action on emissions reduction strategies focused on emissions abatement, and to make additional investments in renewable electricity, process and equipment optimization, and energy conservation.

Qualcomm has established near- and long-term science-based emissions reduction targets, which have been approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), including: (1) reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions by 50% by 2030 from a 2020 base year; (2) reduce absolute Scope 3 GHG emissions by 25% by 2030 from a 2020 base year; and (3) reach net-zero GHG emissions across the value chain by 2040.
